exercises.name: 1-Arm Cable Pulldown
exercises.note: Control the negative and feel your lats pulling apart. Full ROM!

exercises.name: 1-Arm Reverse Pec Deck
exercises.note: Sweep the weight out to create the largest semi-circle possible with your arm.

exercises.name: 2-Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.note: Two grips: wide overhand (1.5× shoulder width) and underhand (shoulder width).

exercises.name: 2-Grip Pull-Up
exercises.note: Two grips: wide overhand (1.5× shoulder width) and underhand (shoulder width).

exercises.name: 45° Hyperextension
exercises.note: Maintain a neutral lower back, set your hips back, don't allow your spine to round.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.note: Control the eccentric: 2–3 seconds down.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.note: Slow, controlled reps!

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.note: Squeeze your glutes hard at the top and control the weight on the way down.

exercises.name: Barbell Incline Press
exercises.note: A 30° or 45° bench will work here. Pause for 1 second at the bottom of each rep while maintaining tension on the pecs.

exercises.name: Barbell Lunge
exercises.note: Minimize contribution from your back leg!

exercises.name: Barbell RDL
exercises.note: Stick your glutes straight back as you lower the bar straight down, centered over the middle of your foot. Get a nice deep stretch at the bottom, but keep your spine neutral (don't round forward).

exercises.name: Barbell Shrug
exercises.note: Think about shrugging "up to your ears". Use straps, if possible.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.note: Get as deep as you can without excessive back rounding.

exercises.name: Bent-Knee Dragon Flag
exercises.note: Keep your body as rigid as possible throughout the ROM.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.note: Round your back as you crunch.

exercises.name: Cable Flye
exercises.note: Focus on bringing your inner elbows together - not your hands.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.note: Raise your arm "out", not "up". Mind-muscle connection with the middle fibers.

exercises.name: Cable Shoulder Press
exercises.note: Bring cables all the way down to shoulder height, keep torso upright.

exercises.name: Cable Shrug-In
exercises.note: Think about shrugging "up to your ears". Use straps, if possible.

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Kickback
exercises.note: Keep your upper arm behind your torso throughout the ROM.

exercises.name: Cable Wrist Curl
exercises.note: Smooth, controlled reps.

exercises.name: Cable Wrist Extension
exercises.note: Smooth, controlled reps.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported DB Row
exercises.note: Flare elbows out at roughly 45° and squeeze your shoulder blades together hard at the top of each rep.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Machine Row
exercises.note: Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top, control the weight.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Dip
exercises.note: Keep your upper arm behind your torso throughout the ROM.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.note: Lean back by ~15° and drive your elbows down as you squeeze your shoulder blades together. This should feel like a mix of lats and mid-traps.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Pull-Up
exercises.note: Lean back by ~15° and drive your elbows down as you squeeze your shoulder blades together. This should feel like a mix of lats and mid-traps.

exercises.name: DB Bench Press
exercises.note: 1 second pause at the bottom of each rep while maintaining tension on the pecs.

exercises.name: DB Curl
exercises.note: Palms start neutral at the bottom and supinate (palms up) as you curl. Do both arms at the same time.

exercises.name: DB Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.note: Start with your weaker leg. Squat deep.

exercises.name: DB Flye
exercises.note: Focus on bringing your inner elbows together - not your hands.

exercises.name: DB French Press
exercises.note: Arc the dumbbell behind your head, constant tension on the triceps.

exercises.name: Incline DB Curl
exercises.note: Brace upper back against bench, 45 degree incline, keep shoulders back as you curl.

exercises.name: DB Incline Press
exercises.note: A 30° or 45° bench will work here. Pause for 1 second at the bottom of each rep while maintaining tension on the pecs.

exercises.name: DB Lateral Raise
exercises.note: Raise the dumbbells "out", not "up". Mind-muscle connection with the middle fibers.

exercises.name: DB Lunge
exercises.note: Minimize contribution from your back leg!

exercises.name: DB Preacher Curl
exercises.note: Keep your triceps firmly pinned against the pad as you curl. Smooth controlled reps.

exercises.name: DB Romanian Deadlift
exercises.note: Maintain a neutral lower back, set your hips back, don't allow your spine to round.

exercises.name: DB Step-Up
exercises.note: Focus on squeezing your quads to make the weight move.

exercises.name: DB Walking Lunge
exercises.note: Minimize contribution from your back leg!

exercises.name: DB Wrist Curl
exercises.note: Smooth, controlled reps.

exercises.name: DB Wrist Extension
exercises.note: Smooth, controlled reps.

exercises.name: Donkey Calf Raise
exercises.note: 1-2 second pause at the bottom of each rep. Instead of just going up onto your toes, think about rolling your ankle back and forth on the balls of your feet.

exercises.name: Dragon Flag
exercises.note: Keep your body as rigid as possible throughout the ROM.

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Preacher Curl
exercises.note: Keep your triceps firmly pinned against the pad as you curl. Smooth controlled reps.

exercises.name: Glute-Ham Raise
exercises.note: Keep your hips straight.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.note: Medium-width stance; don't let your lower back round.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.note: Feet lower on the platform for more quad focus. Get as deep as you can without excessive back rounding.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.note: Knees to chest, controlled reps, straighten legs more to increase difficulty.

exercises.name: Helms DB Row
exercises.note: Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top, control the weight.

exercises.name: High Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.note: Set the cable at roughly hip height. Let your hand go slightly past your midline at the bottom of each rep to get a deep stretch on the side delt.

exercises.name: Incline Chest-Supported DB Row
exercises.note: Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together, drive your elbows down and back.

exercises.name: Incline DB Kelso Shrug
exercises.note: Pause for about 1 second at the top and then allow your shoulder blades to peel apart on the way back down, under control.

exercises.name: Incline DB Y-Raise
exercises.note: Use a 30° incline bench (back against the bench) and lift the weight up and out in a Y shape.

exercises.name: Incline Machine Press
exercises.note: Sink the handles as low as you comfortably can.

exercises.name: Inverse Zottman Curl
exercises.note: Hammer curl on concentric, supinated curl (palms up) on the eccentric.

exercises.name: Machine Kelso Shrug
exercises.note: Pause for about 1 second at the top and then allow your shoulder blades to peel apart on the way back down, under control.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.note: Control the negative and feel your lats pulling apart. Full ROM!

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.note: Control the negative and feel your lats pulling apart. Full ROM!

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.note: Focus on squeezing your quads to make the weight move.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.note: Feet lower on the platform for more quad focus. Get as deep as you can without excessive back rounding.

exercises.name: Leg Press Calf Press
exercises.note: 1-2 second pause at the bottom of each rep. Instead of just going up onto your toes, think about rolling your ankle back and forth on the balls of your feet.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Raise
exercises.note: Keep your body as rigid as possible throughout the ROM.

exercises.name: Lying Reverse DB Flye
exercises.note: Sweep the weight out to create the largest semi-circle possible with your arm.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.note: 1 second pause at the bottom of each rep while maintaining tension on the pecs.

exercises.name: Machine Crunch
exercises.note: Round your back as you crunch.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction Machine
exercises.note: If possible, place foam pads in between the outside of your knees and the pads on the machine. This will increase your range of motion on the machine.

exercises.name: Machine Hip Thrust
exercises.note: Squeeze your glutes hard at the top and control the weight on the way down.

exercises.name: Machine Lateral Raise
exercises.note: Raise your arms "out", not "up". Mind-muscle connection with the middle fibers.

exercises.name: Machine Preacher Curl
exercises.note: Keep your triceps firmly pinned against the pad as you curl. Smooth controlled reps.

exercises.name: Machine Pulldown
exercises.note: Control the negative and feel your lats pulling apart. Full ROM!

exercises.name: Machine Row
exercises.note: Be ultra strict with form, drive elbows out and back at 45 degree angle.

exercises.name: Machine Shrug
exercises.note: Think about shrugging "up to your ears". Use straps, if possible.

exercises.name: Machine Squat
exercises.note: Get as deep as you can without excessive back rounding.

exercises.name: Modified Zottman Curl
exercises.note: Hammer curl on the way up and supinated curl (palms up) on the way down.

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
exercises.note: Feel a deep stretch on the triceps throughout the entire negative.

exercises.name: Overhead DB Triceps Extension
exercises.note: Feel a deep stretch on the triceps throughout the entire negative.

exercises.name: Pec Deck
exercises.note: Focus on bringing your inner elbows together - not your hands.

exercises.name: Pendlay Row
exercises.note: Initiate the movement by squeezing your shoulder blades together, pull to your lower chest, avoid using momentum.

exercises.name: Decline Plate Crunch
exercises.note: Round your back as you crunch.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Pull-Up
exercises.note: Control the negative and feel your lats pulling apart. Full ROM!

exercises.name: Reverse Cable Crossover
exercises.note: Sweep the weight out to create the largest semi-circle possible with your arm.

exercises.name: Reverse Crunch
exercises.note: Knees to chest, controlled reps, straighten legs more to increase difficulty.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Kelso Shrug
exercises.note: Pause for about 1 second at the top and then allow your shoulder blades to peel apart on the way back down, under control.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.note: Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together, drive your elbows down and back.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.note: Press all the way up to your toes, stretch your calves at the bottom, don't bounce.

exercises.name: Seated DB Shoulder Press
exercises.note: Bring the dumbbells all the way down, keep your torso upright.

exercises.name: Seated Dip Machine
exercises.note: Keep your upper arm behind your torso throughout the ROM.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.note: Set the machine so that you get the biggest stretch possible at the bottom. Prevent your butt from popping up as you curl.

exercises.name: 1-Arm DB Row
exercises.note: Brace with your non-working hand against your knee, stay light, emphasize form.

exercises.name: 1-Leg Leg Press
exercises.note: High and wide foot positioning, start with weaker leg.

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
exercises.note: Feel a deep stretch on the triceps throughout the entire negative.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
exercises.note: 1 second pause at the bottom of each rep while maintaining tension on the pecs.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Incline Press
exercises.note: A 30° or 45° bench will work here. Pause for 1 second at the bottom of each rep while maintaining tension on the pecs.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Lunge
exercises.note: Minimize contribution from your back leg!

exercises.name: Smith Machine Seated Press
exercises.note: Use a controlled eccentric of about two seconds. Keep your position and don't drop through the bottom. Use a neutral or otherwise comfortable grip and a pain-free bottom range.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Squat
exercises.note: Get as deep as you can without excessive back rounding.

exercises.name: DB Spider Curl
exercises.note: Brace your chest against an incline bench, curl with your elbows slightly in front of you.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.note: Press all the way up to your toes, stretch your calves at the bottom, don't bounce.

exercises.name: Standing DB Arnold Press
exercises.note: Start with your elbows in front of you and palms facing in. Rotate the dumbbells so that your palms face forward as you press.

exercises.name: Step-Up
exercises.note: Focus on squeezing your quads to make your body move.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
exercises.note: Reset and brace every rep and lower under control.

exercises.name: T-Bar Row
exercises.note: Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top, control the weight.

exercises.name: Triceps Pressdown
exercises.note: You can use a rope or bar attachment for these, whichever you find more comfortable.

exercises.name: Weighted Crunch
exercises.note: Round your lower back as you crunch. Maintain a mind-muscle connection with your 6-pack.

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Up
exercises.note: Think about pulling your elbows "down" and "in".
